As a Software Engineer I within the Rocket Mortgage Servicing Tech team, you are an emerging engineer eager to grow your expertise in building AI-enabled developer tooling and agentic systems. You have solid foundational software engineering skills and are ready to learn how to design and work with agentic workflows under the guidance of experienced mentors. You’re comfortable with modern development practices, CI/CD fundamentals, and are excited to explore how AI can enhance the software development lifecycle. Your contributions will help our servicing platform teams work more effectively while you build deep expertise in this rapidly evolving field.

About the Role

Develop components of developer tooling and AI-assisted engineering workflows under the guidance of senior engineers, learning how to integrate AI capabilities into the development process.
Contribute to building and testing AI integrations with tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor, gaining hands-on experience with agentic AI systems.
Participate in designing context engineering systems, including working with prompt management, knowledge packaging, and basic evaluation frameworks.
Support integration of AI capabilities into CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and developer feedback loops under code review and mentorship.
Build reusable components, helper functions, and utilities that support developer tooling and automation efforts across teams.
Collaborate with senior engineers to identify workflow improvements and implement technical solutions with appropriate oversight and review.
Learn and apply best practices in AI tooling evaluation and contribute to documenting lessons learned for team adoption.

About You
Minimum Qualifications

Strong foundational software engineering fundamentals with experience designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software systems.
2+ years of professional software engineering experience with demonstrated growth and learning capability.
Proficiency in at least one modern programming language and familiarity with CI/CD, testing, or developer tooling concepts.
Willingness to learn agentic workflows and AI-assisted development practices under mentorship.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor in personal or professional projects.
Experience or coursework in prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or LLM fundamentals.
Familiarity with API development, platform engineering, or internal tooling projects.
Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and adapt to emerging technologies and methodologies.

 

What you’ll get 

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks. 

On-Call Expectations 
This role may include participation in an on-call rotation to support production systems and ensure service reliability. On-call responsibilities may include coverage during nights and weekends. If applicable, frequency and scheduling will be determined by team needs and communicated accordingly. 

 

About us 

Rocket is a Detroit-based company made up of businesses that provide simple, fast and trusted digital solutions for complex transactions. The name comes from our flagship business, now known as Rocket Mortgage®, which was founded in 1985. Today, we’re a publicly traded company involved in many different industries, including mortgages, fintech, real estate and more. We’re insistently different in how we look at the world and are committed to an inclusive workplace where every voice is heard. Apply today to join a team that offers career growth, amazing benefits and the chance to work with leading industry professionals.
